projectManagerFork.viewsWelcome.git.cont:
No projects detected.
In order to detect Git projects, you have to configure the `baseFolders` where the Git projects are.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22projectManagerFork.git.baseFolders%22%5D)
[I don't need Git projects](command:projectManagerFork.hideGitWelcome)
It also supports detection of SVN or Mercurial repositories, VS Code or any other folder.
To learn more about how to use Project Manager in VS Code [read the docs](https://github.com/alefragnani/vscode-project-manager/#available-settings).

projectManagerFork.configuration.project: Indicates an alternative location (folder path) where the `projects.json` file is stored

Indicates folders or [glob patterns](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) to be ignored when searching for projects
